{{Quote|Stormtrooper Command governs the military operations of the Stormtrooper Corps.|[[TX-5532]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Stormtrooper Command''' was the leading command organization of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], composed of the highest ranking [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. If any [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were incompetent, they were forced to serve in the Corps itself, or more commonly, they were simply executed for their incompetence.
